title: Composition over inheritance: fill slots, don't extend

slides.say: Coming from classes, you might want a base component that others extend. React has a simpler tool: composition.
Need more than one hole? Use named props. JSX is just a value, so you can pass whole components as left and right.
Need a special version? Don't subclass Dialog. Render it and configure it with props. That's called specialization.

slides.text: Sharing non-UI logic? Put it in a plain module or a custom Hook, and import it.
slides.say: And for logic that isn't UI, put it in a plain module or a custom Hook, and import it. The React team found no case where component inheritance was the better choice.
